caption:
Column dhalai mein sahi handling ke saath PP shuttering sheet ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai.

Paani aur seelan se sheet kharab nahi hoti aur column setting aasan rehti hai. Raipur, Durg, Bhilai se pan-India dispatch uplabdh hai.
